Team — quick, two-minute read and requests for tomorrow's 10:30 PT rollcall. We need to lock the high-confidence lanes and surface evidence for any deals we expect to count in next week's submission. Please do the following by EOD today: 

1) Stage hygiene: move deals to the correct stage in HubSpot and add a one-line rationale (close date, blocker, action owner).
2) Evidence packets: upload deal artifacts to the Drive folder linked below (POs, legal redlines, SOC/SLA exceptions, procurement notes). Use the attached evidence_packet_template.pdf as the cover page.
3) Call agenda: be prepared to give a 2-minute update per deal (ask, risk, next milestone). We'll triage anything above $100k during the call.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_forecast_evidence
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4582

Attachments: evidence_packet_template.pdf (PDF - cover template)

Thanks — if you foresee pushback from procurement or need artifact help, loop Sarah (Acme finance) so we can get that turned around before the rollcall.
